propositions: TarFile.extractall at test_build_provenance.py:143 is called without an explicit filter= argument, triggering CPython 3.12+ DeprecationWarning about Python 3.14's future default tar extraction filter behavior.

The test fails when DeprecationWarning is promoted to an error via pytest -W error::DeprecationWarning, indicating the warning is deterministic and blocks test passage under strict warning-as-error enforcement.

The generated sdist contains five relative regular files with 0644 mode and no special entries; applying tarfile.data_filter rejects none and only modifies ownership fields to None, leaving provenance assertions unchanged.
The extractall call site is local to a single test with no external callers depending on implicit extraction behavior or ownership restoration.
Repository prior art in scripts/measure_baseline_normalization.py and scripts/mutation_gate.py use the identical filter=data policy, establishing precedent for the safe extraction standard.
